situations.title: 유도 전 모니터 부착
situations.tagline: We're placing a few monitors on you before you drift off — you'll just feel some little stickers.
situations.brief: 마취 유도 전 환자에게 모니터 부착 과정을 설명하며 안심시키세요.
keyPhrases: These stickers let us watch your heart and breathing.
The cuff on your arm will squeeze now and then.
You're doing great — this is all routine.

situations.title: 사전 산소화 보조
situations.tagline: Just breathe normally through the mask for me — this oxygen keeps you safe while you fall asleep.
situations.brief: 마취 유도 전 환자의 preoxygenation을 보조하며 마스크 호흡을 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: Take slow, deep breaths through the mask.
This builds up your oxygen before we start.
You're breathing perfectly — keep it steady.

situations.title: 삽관 기구 준비
situations.tagline: Let's have the blade, tube, and stylet ready — what size ET tube do you want for him?
situations.brief: 삽관에 필요한 물품을 점검하고 마취의와 규격을 확인해 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: The laryngoscope and tube are ready and checked.
Which tube size and blade would you like?
Stylet and backup are within reach.

situations.title: 흡인기 준비
situations.tagline: Make sure suction is on and within reach before we induce — I want it ready if he vomits.
situations.brief: 유도 전 흡인기를 작동 상태로 준비해 즉시 사용 가능하게 배치하세요.
keyPhrases: Suction is on and tested.
The Yankauer is right here within reach.
I'll keep it ready throughout induction.

situations.title: 유도 약물 확인
situations.tagline: Let's verify the induction drugs together — read me back the propofol and the paralytic doses.
situations.brief: 유도 약물의 종류와 용량을 마취의와 이중 확인해 안전하게 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: Propofol is drawn up and labeled.
Let me read back the paralytic dose to you.
All induction meds are checked and ready.

situations.title: 삽관 후 위치 확인
situations.tagline: Tube's in — let's confirm placement with end-tidal CO2 and bilateral breath sounds.
situations.brief: 삽관 후 ETT 위치를 EtCO2와 호흡음으로 확인해 정확한 삽관을 검증하세요.
keyPhrases: I see a good end-tidal CO2 waveform.
Breath sounds are equal on both sides.
Let's secure the tube at this depth.

situations.title: RSI 윤상연골 압박
situations.tagline: This is a rapid sequence — apply cricoid pressure when I say and hold it until I tell you to release.
situations.brief: RSI 중 윤상연골 압박을 지시에 맞춰 정확히 적용하고 유지하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm ready to apply cricoid pressure on your cue.
I'll hold steady until you tell me to release.
Tell me if you need me to adjust the pressure.

situations.title: 흡인 위험 환자 유도
situations.tagline: He's a full stomach — let's do a rapid sequence induction and keep suction ready.
situations.brief: 흡인 위험이 높은 환자의 RSI 유도를 지원하고 흡인 예방을 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: Suction is on and right at my hand.
I'm ready for cricoid pressure on your cue.
Tube and backup are prepped for a fast intubation.

situations.title: 마스크 환기 보조
situations.tagline: I'm having trouble ventilating — give me a two-handed mask seal while I bag him.
situations.brief: 마스크 환기가 어려운 상황에서 two-hand seal과 기도 개방을 보조하세요.
keyPhrases: I've got a two-handed seal on the mask.
I'll do a jaw thrust to open his airway.
Let's add an oral airway if it's still tight.

situations.title: 삽관 재시도 준비
situations.tagline: First attempt failed — let's reposition, switch blades, and I'll try again on the next pass.
situations.brief: 삽관 실패 후 자세 재조정과 대체 장비를 준비해 재시도를 지원하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll reposition his head into a better sniffing position.
Here's the video laryngoscope for the next attempt.
Let's bag him back up before you try again.

situations.title: 유도 중 저혈압 대응
situations.tagline: His pressure dropped after induction — let's give fluids and I may need a vasopressor.
situations.brief: 유도 중 발생한 저혈압에 수액과 승압제를 준비해 신속히 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Fluids are running wide open now.
Phenylephrine is drawn up and ready.
I'm cycling the blood pressure every minute.

situations.title: 기도 확보 자세 보조
situations.tagline: Help me get him into the sniffing position — I need his ear lined up with his sternal notch.
situations.brief: 삽관을 위한 sniffing position을 정확히 잡도록 환자 자세를 보조하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll place a pad under his head for you.
His ear is now level with the sternal notch.
Tell me if you need the head raised more.

situations.title: 튜브 고정·커프 확인
situations.tagline: Let's secure the tube at twenty-two and check the cuff pressure before we drape.
situations.brief: 삽관 후 튜브 깊이 고정과 커프 압력을 확인해 기도를 안정화하세요.
keyPhrases: Securing the tube at twenty-two centimeters.
Cuff pressure is within the safe range.
Let me confirm it's taped well before draping.

situations.title: 소아 유도 보조
situations.tagline: We'll do an inhalation induction — help me keep the mask gentle on his face as he drifts off.
situations.brief: 소아 흡입 마취 유도를 보조하며 부드러운 마스크 적용과 안정을 지원하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll hold the mask gently and keep him calm.
Ready with the pediatric tube and blade.
Watching his breathing as he goes under.

situations.title: 후두마스크 대안 준비
situations.tagline: If the tube won't pass, I want an LMA ready as a backup — pull the right size for me.
situations.brief: 삽관 대안으로 후두마스크(LMA)를 규격에 맞게 준비해 대기하세요.
keyPhrases: The correct-size LMA is ready and checked.
Cuff is tested and lubricated.
I'll have it in your hand the moment you need it.
goals: 삽관 대안으로 즉시 사용 가능하게 대기한다

situations.title: 삽관 실패 저산소
situations.tagline: I can't intubate and his sats are dropping — go to the difficult airway algorithm and call for help.
situations.brief: 삽관 실패로 저산소가 진행되는 위기에서 어려운 기도 알고리즘 대응을 지원하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm calling for the difficult airway cart and backup.
Let's rescue with an LMA while you reoxygenate.
Surgeon is alerted for a possible surgical airway.
goals: 어려운 기도 알고리즘과 자원을 신속히 동원한다

situations.title: 흡인 발생 대응
situations.tagline: He aspirated — turn him to the side, deep suction now, and let's protect that airway.
situations.brief: 유도 중 흡인이 발생한 상황에서 체위 변경과 흡인, 기도 보호를 지원하세요.
keyPhrases: Suctioning the airway deeply right now.
Turning his head to the side to clear it.
Ready to secure the airway as soon as it's clear.

situations.title: 유도 중 아나필락시스
situations.tagline: He's crashing right after the drugs — this looks like anaphylaxis, get epinephrine and stop the agent.
situations.brief: 유도 중 발생한 아나필락시스를 인지하고 원인 약물 중단과 epinephrine를 지원하세요.
keyPhrases: Stopping the suspected agent immediately.
Epinephrine and fluids are ready to go.
I'm calling for help and the crash cart.

situations.title: 후두경련 발생
situations.tagline: He's laryngospasming — positive pressure and jaw thrust, and draw up succinylcholine now.
situations.brief: 유도 중 후두경련을 인지하고 양압 환기와 응급 약물 준비를 지원하세요.
keyPhrases: Applying positive pressure with a tight seal.
Succinylcholine is drawn up and ready.
Increasing oxygen to one hundred percent.
goals: 후두경련을 즉시 인지하고 양압 환기를 지원한다

situations.title: 산소포화도 급강하
situations.tagline: His sats are dropping fast — bag him with a hundred percent oxygen and let's find the problem.
situations.brief: 유도 중 산소포화도 급강하를 인지하고 산소화 회복을 신속히 지원하세요.
keyPhrases: Bagging with one hundred percent oxygen now.
Checking the seal, the tube, and breath sounds.
Calling for help if he doesn't come up quickly.

situations.title: 외과적 기도 준비
situations.tagline: We can't intubate or ventilate — I need the cricothyrotomy kit open and the surgeon scrubbed in.
situations.brief: 삽관·환기 모두 실패한 위기에서 외과적 기도 준비를 신속히 지원하세요.
keyPhrases: The cricothyrotomy kit is open and ready.
The surgeon is at the head of the bed now.
I'm calling for all available help.
